notes:
Summary: HarborWave is a mid-market product analytics SaaS building an in‑app product assistant (help + contextual tips) + personalization layer backed by embeddings and a reranker. Primary ask: start with Hosted API (fast proof) then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation. Cost is a material decision — target is ~40% reduction in per-call cost vs current baseline by using batching/caching/quantization and smarter routing.

Technical requirements / constraints: p95 chat latency target ~150-200ms (interactive flows), embeddings throughput ~150-200 reqs/s for nightly batch index updates, strict PII handling (KMS + audit logs), SSO required (Okta). Data residency not strict today but prefer US regions.

POC plan: 2-week hosted POC to capture baseline latency/cost; then one cost-optimization workshop with Redwood infra/optimize team to tune batching, cache TTLs, and quant profiles; expected delta -> iterate and present Dedicated sizing + committed pricing.

What we demoed: streaming responses, embeddings index latencies, per-token cost breakdown in Console, fallback routing to smaller 7B variant for cost-sensitive endpoints.

Workshop highlights (11/07):
- Agreed experiments: 1) continuous batching (client + runtime), 2) prefix/KV cache for repeat prompts (session reuse), 3) quantized 13B int8 path for non-critical prompts, 4) per-route routing to cheaper model for lower importance flows.
- Redwood to provide unit economics spreadsheet with sample traffic and recommended batching sizes + expected token reductions.
- HarborWave will provide 7 days of production-like traces by 11/15 for further modeling.

Quotes / paraphrase: "We need predictable unit economics before committing to dedicated GPUs — if we can shave 30-50% off token costs, this makes the ROI simple." — HW Head of Product.

Risks / open items: finance needs committed pricing model for budgeting; infosec requires SOC2 evidence + KMS integration plan; legal asked about data retention controls for user data used in embeddings.

Next steps (short): "Run hosted POC -> collect traces"; "Redwood to deliver cost model + dedicated sizing"; "infosec review turnaround 2 weeks".
